resources.string: AirLabs API key not configured. Open API Configuration to connect your key or gateway.
No internet connection. Showing cached data where available.

Flight Tracker stores your API credentials encrypted locally on-device using Android Keystore. Flight, airport, airline, and weather queries are sent directly to your configured AirLabs endpoint (or backend gateway) and Open-Meteo. Location is used solely on demand for Nearby Airports and Map centering.
